description: Semantic MCP block/table tools (document_editor_insert_block/delete_block/move_block/update_block/set_table_cell_text). Insert paragraph/heading/list/quote blocks into the body (order-value semantics) or table cells (index semantics), move/delete/replace blocks and set table-cell text; compile into canonical insertBlock/deleteBlock/moveBlock/updateBlock/setBlockAttribute operations applied through the same pipeline as document_editor_apply_operations. Operation patterns are pinned by the C#/JS convergence fixture.
